context: Add node_modules to the codespell --skip list (verify no other gitignored vendored trees are scanned the same way - check for .venv-style dirs already listed and any new ones).
description: The codespell invocation at Makefile:942 passes a --skip list that omits node_modules. results-explorer/.gitignore ignores node_modules/, so any developer who has run the explorer's npm install has thousands of vendored files scanned, and codespell exits non-zero on their typos. That fails make spellcheck -> make ci-lint -> make pr-preflight. CI never installs those deps, so the gate is green in CI and red locally - the inverse of what a preflight is for, and it trains agents/humans to skip the gate. Observed while running preflight for #1333.

preserves.behavior: Real source-tree typos are still caught by spellcheck

verifications.description: spellcheck passes in a worktree that has results-explorer npm deps installed

work_units.evidence: Makefile:942 codespell --skip gains node_modules; make spellcheck exit 0 in pool-09 WITH results-explorer/node_modules present (was exit 65). Must-preserve validated by injecting 'recieve' into tracked docs/README.md - still flagged, gate exit 2. Sweep: no other currently-present gitignored tree produces hits (.venv/.ruff_cache/.pytest_cache/.todo-db/egg-info/__pycache__ all clean); latent same-class risk is the gitignored agent skill mirrors (.codex/.gemini/.antigravity/skills) - NOT skipped because .claude/skills holds tracked content and a blanket skip would cut real coverage. Rejected a git-ls-files-driven invocation: passing explicit paths defeats the directory skips and re-exposes tracked vendored TPC-H binaries.
work_units.summary: Add node_modules to the codespell skip list and sweep for other vendored trees
